europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Spain's Prime Minister blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco, with most returning to Morocco. Spain faces diplomatic challenges due to the influx.

europe_now.title: European Wildfires
europe_now.summary: Greece orders partial evacuations in Athens suburb as wildfires burn, and France's mega fire has eased but firefighters still face significant dangers. Wildfires pose environmental and public safety risks.

top_stories.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain's Prime Minister attributes the Ceuta migrant influx to traffickers, with 60,000 arrivals and most returning to Morocco. The situation highlights border security challenges.

top_stories.title: European Wildfires
top_stories.summary: Greece evacuates Athens suburbs due to wildfires, while France's mega fire has subsided but risks persist. Wildfires threaten ecosystems and communities across Europe.
